t: Cactus Hill Adventures: Fat Plants are In Vogue
s: I've been to several cacti and succulent plant shows over the past several years and the prevailing favorites on the show benches, with judges and public alike, are the plants with swollen stems and roots. Their popularity began rolling in 1987 when Gordon Rowley wrote his book, Caudiciform & Pachycaul Succulents. Today, they are THE plants to acquire, grow, and show. Alas, I have not joined the masses, as I only have two Fat Plants.
